evidence_contract.null_install_errors: No live installation was attempted or observed; null is not a successful-install receipt.
evidence_contract.source_validation: Static selected-input evidence; not full SDK builds.
evidence_contract.artifact_validation: Prior full byte/SHA/archive checks reused for unchanged catalog artifacts; no blanket live-install inference.
evidence_contract.external_validation: Pinned original metadata and offline planning only; tools must be fetched through the explicit original Store source.
evidence_contract.unresolved_platform: Unknown HMI remains unknown, even if the original parser permits such a tool.
evidence_contract.capabilities: mguNeeds is an installed capability gate, not an instruction to auto-install a provider.
evidence_contract.user_reports: MTrack 0.1.7 installed per user log only. Earlier Shiftlights 0.4.5 transport outcome remains unknown; current AQ 0.4.6 was not observed on a unit.
evidence_contract.derived_source: AQ source recipe identity is distinct from the unchanged upstream app version; synthetic SDK fixtures verify assembly only.
evidence_contract.current_collection_checks: data/collection-verification-20261119.json; dated older test reports are not current full-suite receipts

id8_limitations: Original AppStudio 1.1.0 declares ID7 only; AQ 1.1.1 is separately derived, with offline ID8 evidence and no publisher claim.
Actual target SDK members and the native renderer protocol/application area must exist. Test doubles are not evidence of target availability.
Unknown/stale speed, read errors or provider loss pause Bimmer Blocks. No game operation is authorized by a cached stationary value on ID8.
If a getter never settles, it retains its slot and the game remains paused; no unbounded retry queue is created.
Vehicle Pass values are personal manual records, not live pressures, verified parts recommendations or CBS updates.
Target installation, registration and physical UI/controller/speed behavior have not been observed.
